data.title: Healthcare Triangle Amends Equity Funding Agreement Terms
data.description:
Healthcare Triangle ( (HCTI) ) has issued an announcement.

On September 22, 2026, Healthcare Triangle amended its June 12, 2026 equity purchase agreement with Hudson Global Ventures, adjusting key financing terms that govern how the company can raise capital through equity puts to the investor. The changes refine the definitions of purchase price and valuation period, significantly lower the maximum amount per put notice from $2,500,000 to $250,000, and raise the minimum share price threshold from $0.01 to $0.10, while adding a new change-of-control clause that cuts off the company’s ability to issue additional put notices if control of the company shifts, potentially tightening but stabilizing its access to equity funding.

These revisions suggest Healthcare Triangle is rebalancing its capital-raising framework to limit large discounted issuances and protect share value, which may reduce dilution risk for existing shareholders and signal a more conservative funding approach. At the same time, the reduced flexibility in put size and the change-of-control limitation could constrain rapid equity financing during strategic transactions, affecting how the company can tap this facility for future growth or restructuring needs.

data.description:

data.title: Fusion Fuel Green to Restate 2025 Financials After Currency and Goodwill Errors
data.description:
Fusion Fuel Green ( (HTOO) ) just unveiled an announcement.

On September 23, 2026, Fusion Fuel Green disclosed that its audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2025 must be restated due to errors in foreign currency translation of intangibles and goodwill tied to its acquisition of Quality Industrial Corp. The company also identified misclassification of foreign exchange differences and the need to redo its goodwill impairment analysis for that period.

Fusion Fuel Green plans to file an amended annual report with expanded disclosure on the restatement, and currently estimates the corrections will increase its 2025 net loss by about €4.0 million and reduce equity by roughly €3.8 million. Management emphasizes that the adjustments are non-cash, do not affect revenue, cash or net cash flows, and are not expected to jeopardize its Nasdaq listing, though the figures remain preliminary and subject to further audit review.
